title: Goth
lyrics:
[00:58.85]Place me, place me
[01:03.04]Place me in my casket
[01:24.41]Place me in my casket tonight
[01:28.39]Because I'm already dying inside
[01:32.76]Pale skin so cold to the touch
[01:36.95]Like a rose in bloom when we blush
[01:41.10]Dark eyes meet under the sky
[01:45.16]The stars are out, we're alive in the night
[01:49.24]My hollow heart finds it too hard to trust
[01:53.34]We're all alone until we turn back to dust
[02:30.89]Place me, place me
[02:34.91]Place me in my casket
